details.subjective_justification: The agent followed a clear logical chain: identified the bug in nested CompoundModels, traced through the code to find the root cause in the `_cstack` function (line 245 assigning `1` instead of `right`), applied a minimal one-line fix, verified it resolved the issue, and confirmed all tests pass with no errors encountered.

The agent identified the core issue (RST.__init__ not accepting header_rows) but the fix was marked incorrect and the agent ran out of turns without diagnosing why or attempting alternative approaches; the reasoning became disjointed as the agent rushed to submit without verifying the solution.

The agent correctly identified the root cause (case-sensitive regex matching in QDP command parsing), applied a focused fix (adding re.IGNORECASE flag), and verified it with comprehensive testing; the reasoning was mostly clear and logical with only minor tangential exploration of the codebase.
